title: Archviz
summary: Realtime VR walkthroughs of architecture that does not exist yet.
description: Unbuilt buildings presented as immersive VR walkthroughs — spatial scale, materials, and light readable at full scale before anything is constructed.

title: Wild Science
summary: Six-episode series on the hidden traits and remarkable abilities of selected animals.
description: A documentary-style Unreal production covering traits that are well known in science but rarely captured on screen — each episode built around one species and its underexplored skills.

title: VR Showroom
summary: VR for teaching and presenting ideas, objects, and spaces that are hard to grasp or costly to show in person.
description: An educational VR showroom — abstract concepts, fragile artifacts, and large-scale environments presented interactively when physical demos are impractical or impossible.

title: Dinopark VR
summary: Short VR animated film spanning three dinosaur epochs.
description: A compact VR experience — stylized prehistoric worlds from three geological periods, told as a single immersive animated short.

title: SOMA
description: A focused realtime product spot — lighting, materials, and camera work built around a single hero asset.

title: Kleeya
description: A focused realtime product spot — lighting, materials, and camera work built around a single hero asset.

title: This Portfolio
summary: The site you're looking at — static, tagged, and pre-rendered.
description: A black-and-white one-pager with frosted glass and tag filters, pre-rendered at build time and deployed through GitHub Actions. Free to host, previewed on its own dev environment, and edited through a small admin of its own rather than a third-party CMS.
